headline: 12-Year-Old's Diaper Drive Delivers 30,000 Diapers to Phoenix Food Bank
meta_description: A middle schooler's fifth annual diaper drive exceeded its goal, delivering 30,000 diapers to Nourish Phoenix food bank after noticing empty shelves years ago.
summary_short: Twelve-year-old Sloan's annual diaper drive collected 30,000 diapers for a Phoenix food bank—surpassing her 22,500-unit goal in her fifth year organizing the effort.
body:
A U-Haul truck pulled up to Nourish Phoenix's food bank in Phoenix with a cargo that left staff amazed: 30,000 disposable diapers, all collected by 12-year-old Sloan as part of her fifth annual "Diaper Drive." The haul so completely filled her house that there was barely room to walk—a striking testament to the generosity Sloan has mobilized since she was just seven years old. Though her 2024 goal was 22,500 diapers, the donations kept flowing in until she had exceeded that target by roughly one-third, with Huggies, Pampers, and Bluey brands all represented in the final collection.

Sloan's dedication to this cause traces back to a moment of observation. While volunteering at Nourish Phoenix years ago, she noticed an empty section on the shelves at the food bank's location on 9th Avenue. When she asked staff why, they explained that diapers—always among the most requested items—had run out. That simple discovery sparked an idea that would grow into an annual tradition. "If we have the ability to give someone something that they might not have or need, it's really important to do that," Sloan told ABC 15 as her drive concluded at the end of August.

For Sloan's mother, watching her child's commitment to helping others has been a source of profound pride. The motivation behind the drive is straightforward but powerful: recognizing a genuine need in the community and taking concrete action to meet it. At an age when many peers are focused on school and hobbies, Sloan has chosen to channel her energy into ensuring that families relying on the food bank have access to essential supplies their children depend on.
quick_facts: Sloan, 12, collected 30,000 diapers for her fifth annual drive
Goal was 22,500 diapers; actual collection exceeded it by 7,500
Nourish Phoenix food bank location at 510 9th Avenue in Phoenix
Sloan started the drive at age 7 after volunteering at the food bank
Drive concluded at end of August; diapers among most-requested items
